{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data and apply all preprocessing steps
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Remove QC-failed baseline values
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
df = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Correct batch B values: divide biomarker_final by 10
df.loc[df['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Now check if arm and severity are imbalanced
crosstab = pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity'])
print("Cross-tabulation of arm vs severity:")
print(crosstab)

# Compute response rates by arm
treatment_response_rate = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
control_response_rate = df[df['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()

# Compute difference in proportions (treatment - control)
treatment_effect = treatment_response_rate - control_response_rate

print(f"Treatment response rate: {treatment_response_rate:.3f}")
print(f"Control response rate: {control_response_rate:.3f}")
print(f"Treatment effect (diff in proportions): {treatment_effect:.3f}")

# Return values for submission
treatment_effect"}
